jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: Arlington School District, a town school district in the Southwest Vermont Supervisory Union (member town: Arlington).
Southwest Vermont Supervisory Union (official site hosting the district's documents).

sources.note: Arlington School District Family Handbook 2026-27 (the board's own current listing): five directors -- Todd Wilkins (Chair), Dan Wood (Vice-Chair), Teresa Sweet (Clerk), Nicol Whalen, Chelsea Thompson -- with staggered terms expiring 2026/2027/2028, the section 423(b) five-member town board, elected at-large by the town's voters.
